Name: Horizontal Floor Dividers (Custom Furniture)
Author: Apocalypse1734
Description:
I couldn't find any mods that added horizontal floor dividers, so I decided to put my mediocre pixel art skills to use.

I adapted all of the vanilla floor divider styles into new horizontal, corner and matching vertical dividers.

I have not tested all of them, however I did find a bug with the thin mahogany style dividers, in that some of the corners turned into signs when placed. As this is my first mod, I have no experience whatsoever in diagnosing or remedying the issue, so unfortunately this issue is unlikely to be fixed at this time.

Manifest.Name: Custom Floor Dividers
Manifest.Description: Adds horizontal and corner floor dividers, as well as matching vertical dividers.
Manifest.Author: Apocalypse1734
